mods.name: mlog-assertions-8
mods.author: cardillan
mods.description:
This mod aims to make debugging in Mindustry Logic a bit easier:[[]lightgray]

Enhanced [[]accent]Vars[[]] screen: full precision values, sorting and filtering variables, copying variables to the clipboard.

[[]accent]Memory[[]] screen for inspecting contents of memory blocks, using the same interface as the [[]accent]Vars[[]] screen.

Settings for overriding instruction limit, by up to 1000 instructions, to make space for additional debugging code.

[[]accent]Snapshots[[]] allow saving, reviewing and restoring the state of logic processors, memory blocks and other entities.

A [[]accent]profiler[[]] for gathering statistics about program execution.

[[]accent]Logging[[]]: a custom `log` instruction can create ligging messages that can be later inspected from the UI.

Custom mlog instructions for performing runtime checks, logging messages, reporting errors, triggering a breakpoint, taking snaphots and managing profiling.

Visual indication of stopped processors, processors executing a [[]accent]wait[[]] instruction, and failed runtime checks, directly on the map.

[[]white]Using this mod on maps with lots of processors may impact the game's performance.[[]]

See the [[]accent]README.md[[]] file in the mod's GitHub repository for more information.

mods.name: exoprosopa
mods.author: TnmSpiroct
mods.description:
[[]#93E2EE]Exoprosopa[[]] adds a new planet, Frostnova, into the game.
  Frostnova is a deceptively frozen planet. A volatile and hazardous tundra hides a dormant faction, Astral.
  It has a fully playable campaign with 20 campaign and 11 optional maps. 
  
  Polished content & linear campaign progression.
  Contains over 320 pieces of unique content, including blocks, liquids, items, units and specialized guardian.
  Pure modded without reuse any vanilla content.
  
  [accent[]]If you find any issues or want to gives suggestions
  feel free to join the Exoprosopa Discord server.
  Check it on my profile. My username is tnmspiroctmain[[]].
  
  [[]#93E2EE]Exoprosopa[[]] is available in the following languages:
  - English
  - Indonesian
  - Russian
  - Simplified Chinese

Enjoy!
